42	// MinContextWindow returns the minimum context window the request requires,
43	// derived from EstimatedPromptTokens with a safety margin.
44	func (r Request) MinContextWindow() int {
45		if r.EstimatedPromptTokens <= 0 {
46			return 0
47		}
48		// 1.25x safety margin for response tokens + tool overhead.
49		return r.EstimatedPromptTokens + r.EstimatedPromptTokens/4

351	// Resolve runs the engine end-to-end and returns a Decision.
352	//
353	// The engine:
354	//  1. Enumerates (harness, provider, model) candidates from inputs.
355	//  2. Applies gating (capability, override, model-pin, surface).
356	//  3. Scores per profile policy with cooldown demotion + perf bias.
357	//  4. Sorts viable → score → cost → locality → name.
358	//  5. Returns the top viable candidate with the full ranked list.
359	//
360	// Returns an error only when no viable candidate exists.
361	func Resolve(req Request, in Inputs) (*Decision, error) {
362		if in.Now.IsZero() {
363			in.Now = time.Now()
364		}
365	
366		canonicalHarness := req.Harness
367		if canonicalHarness == "local" {
368			canonicalHarness = "agent"
369		}
370	
371		var ranked []rankedCandidate
372		for _, h := range in.Harnesses {
373			// TestOnly harnesses (script/virtual) only reachable via explicit override.
374			if h.TestOnly && canonicalHarness != h.Name {
375				continue
376			}
377			// Automatic profile/tier routing is restricted to harnesses with full
378			// coverage. Explicit Harness pins can still use experimental/ad-hoc
379			// harnesses.
380			if canonicalHarness == "" && !h.AutoRoutingEligible {
381				continue
382			}
383			// Hard harness override: skip non-matching harnesses.
384			if canonicalHarness != "" && canonicalHarness != h.Name {
385				continue
386			}
387			entries := buildHarnessCandidates(h, req, in)
388			ranked = append(ranked, entries...)
389		}
390	
391		// Compute scores.
392		for i := range ranked {
393			ranked[i].out.Score = scorePolicy(req.Profile, ranked[i].internal)
394			if ranked[i].out.Eligible {
395				ranked[i].out.Reason = fmt.Sprintf("profile=%s; score=%.1f", req.Profile, ranked[i].out.Score)
396			}
397		}
398		neutralCost, hasKnownCost := neutralKnownCost(ranked)
399	
400		// Sort: eligible first, then descending score, then cost, then locality,
401		// then alphabetical.
402		sort.SliceStable(ranked, func(i, j int) bool {
403			ei, ej := ranked[i].out.Eligible, ranked[j].out.Eligible
404			if ei != ej {
405				return ei
406			}
407			if !ei {
408				return ranked[i].out.Harness < ranked[j].out.Harness
409			}
410			if ranked[i].out.Score != ranked[j].out.Score {
411				return ranked[i].out.Score > ranked[j].out.Score
412			}
413			if hasKnownCost {
414				ci := candidateCostTieValue(ranked[i], neutralCost)
415				cj := candidateCostTieValue(ranked[j], neutralCost)
416				if ci != cj {
417					return ci < cj
418				}
419			}
420			// Locality tiebreak: prefer local cost-class.
421			li := costClassRank[ranked[i].internal.CostClass] == 0
422			lj := costClassRank[ranked[j].internal.CostClass] == 0
423			if li != lj {
424				return li
425			}
426			if ranked[i].out.Harness != ranked[j].out.Harness {
427				return ranked[i].out.Harness < ranked[j].out.Harness
428			}
429			return ranked[i].out.Provider < ranked[j].out.Provider
430		})
431	
432		out := make([]Candidate, len(ranked))
433		for i := range ranked {
434			out[i] = ranked[i].out
435		}
436	
437		if err := explicitPinError(req, in); err != nil {
438			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, err
439		}
440	
441		for i := range out {
442			if out[i].Eligible {
443				return &Decision{
444					Harness:    out[i].Harness,
445					Provider:   out[i].Provider,
446					Endpoint:   out[i].Endpoint,
447					Model:      out[i].Model,
448					Reason:     fmt.Sprintf("profile=%s; score=%.1f", req.Profile, out[i].Score),
449					Candidates: out,
450				}, nil
451			}
452		}
453		if requested := requestedModelIntent(req); requested != "" && req.Provider == "" && canonicalHarness == "" && hasLiveDiscoveryCandidates(ranked) {
454			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, fmt.Errorf("no live endpoint offers a match for %s", requested)
455		}
456		if missingCapability := missingProfileCapability(req); missingCapability != "" {
457			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, &ErrNoProfileCandidate{
458				Profile:           req.Profile,
459				MissingCapability: missingCapability,
460				Rejected:          len(out),
461			}
462		}
463		return &Decision{Candidates: out}, noViableCandidateError(req, len(out))
464	}

663			SupportedReasoning: h.SupportedReasoning,
664			MaxReasoningTokens: h.MaxReasoningTokens,

666			ExactPinSupport:    h.ExactPinSupport,
667			SupportedModels:    h.SupportedModels,
668		}
669	
670		if !h.Available {
671			return []rankedCandidate{{
672				out: Candidate{
673					Harness:      h.Name,
674					CostSource:   CostSourceUnknown,
675					Reason:       "harness not available",
676					FilterReason: FilterReasonUnhealthy,
677				},
678				internal: candidateInternal{Harness: h.Name, CostClass: h.CostClass, CostSource: CostSourceUnknown},
679			}}
680		}
681	
682		histRate, hasHist := in.HistoricalSuccess[h.Name]
683		if !hasHist {
684			histRate = -1
685		}
686	
687		// Enumerate providers. For harnesses with no providers (subprocess harnesses
688		// with vendor-managed billing), emit a single virtual provider entry.
689		providers := h.Providers
690		if len(providers) == 0 {
691			providers = []ProviderEntry{{Name: ""}}
692		}
693	
694		out := make([]rankedCandidate, 0, len(providers))
695		for _, p := range providers {
696			model, reason := resolveModel(h, p, req, in)
697			ctxWin := 0
698			if p.ContextWindows != nil {
699				ctxWin = p.ContextWindows[model]
700			}
701			entryCaps := caps
702			entryCaps.ContextWindow = ctxWin
703			entryCaps.SupportsTools = caps.SupportsTools || p.SupportsTools
704			if len(p.DiscoveredIDs) > 0 {
705				entryCaps.SupportedModels = nil
706			}
707	
708			key := ProviderModelKey(p.Name, p.EndpointName, model)
709			obs := in.ObservedSpeedTPS[key]
710			if obs == 0 && p.EndpointName != "" {
711				obs = in.ObservedSpeedTPS[ProviderModelKey(p.Name, "", model)]
712			}
713			providerSuccessRate := -1.0
714			if rate, ok := in.ProviderSuccessRate[key]; ok {
715				providerSuccessRate = rate
716			} else if p.EndpointName != "" {
717				if rate, ok := in.ProviderSuccessRate[ProviderModelKey(p.Name, "", model)]; ok {
718					providerSuccessRate = rate
719				}
720			}
721			latencyMS := in.ObservedLatencyMS[key]
722			if latencyMS == 0 && p.EndpointName != "" {
723				latencyMS = in.ObservedLatencyMS[ProviderModelKey(p.Name, "", model)]
724			}
725			power := candidatePower(in.ModelEligibility, model)
726	
727			gateReq := resolveRequestReasoning(req, h.Surface, in.ReasoningResolver)
728	
729			eligible := true
730			var filterReason FilterReason
731			if reason == "" {
732				if g, fr := CheckPowerEligibility(in.ModelEligibility, model, gateReq); g != "" {
733					eligible = false
734					reason = g
735					filterReason = fr
736				} else if g, fr := CheckGating(entryCaps, gateReq); g != "" {
737					eligible = false
738					reason = g
739					filterReason = fr
740				}
741			} else {
742				eligible = false
743				// resolveModel rejection — model resolution is a capability
744				// mismatch with no specific public category, so fall through
745				// to the catch-all.
746				filterReason = FilterReasonScoredBelowTop
747			}
748	
749			// Hard preference filtering.
750			if eligible {
751				switch req.ProviderPreference {
752				case ProviderPreferenceLocalOnly:
753					if !h.IsLocal {
754						eligible = false
755						reason = "preference is local-only"
756						filterReason = FilterReasonUnhealthy
757					}
758				case ProviderPreferenceSubscriptionOnly:
759					if !h.IsSubscription {
760						eligible = false
761						reason = "preference is subscription-only"
762						filterReason = FilterReasonUnhealthy
763					}
764				}
765			}
766	
767			// SubscriptionOK hard gate: a subscription harness with SubscriptionOK=false
768			// (no durable cache, quota cache missing, or routing decision says no)
769			// is ineligible regardless of score.
770			if eligible && h.IsSubscription && !h.SubscriptionOK {
771				eligible = false
772				reason = "subscription quota exhausted"
773				filterReason = FilterReasonUnhealthy
774			}
775	
776			if eligible && req.Provider != "" && req.Provider != candidateProviderIdentity(h, p) {
777				// Hard provider pin: reject every other provider identity, even
778				// when a non-pinned candidate would otherwise score higher.
779				eligible = false

782			}

784			inCooldown := false
785			if p.Name != "" && p.InCooldown {
786				inCooldown = true
787			} else if p.Name != "" && in.CooldownDuration > 0 {
788				if failedAt, ok := in.ProviderCooldowns[p.Name]; ok {
789					if in.Now.Sub(failedAt) < in.CooldownDuration {
790						inCooldown = true
791					}
792				}
793			}
794	
795			ci := candidateInternal{
796				Harness:               h.Name,
797				Provider:              p.Name,
798				EndpointName:          p.EndpointName,
799				Model:                 model,
800				CostClass:             h.CostClass,
801				CostUSDPer1kTokens:    p.CostUSDPer1kTokens,
802				CostSource:            normalizeCostSource(p.CostSource),
803				Power:                 power,
804				IsSubscription:        h.IsSubscription,
805				QuotaOK:               h.QuotaOK,
806				QuotaPercentUsed:      h.QuotaPercentUsed,
807				QuotaStale:            h.QuotaStale,
808				QuotaTrend:            h.QuotaTrend,
809				SubscriptionOK:        h.SubscriptionOK,
810				HistoricalSuccessRate: histRate,
811				ProviderSuccessRate:   providerSuccessRate,
812				ObservedTokensPerSec:  obs,
813				ObservedLatencyMS:     latencyMS,
814				InCooldown:            inCooldown || h.InCooldown,
815				ProviderAffinityMatch: req.Provider != "" && req.Provider == candidateProviderIdentity(h, p),
816				ProviderPreference:    req.ProviderPreference,
817			}
818			out = append(out, rankedCandidate{
819				out: Candidate{
820					Harness:            h.Name,
821					Provider:           p.Name,
822					Endpoint:           p.EndpointName,
823					Model:              model,
824					CostUSDPer1kTokens: p.CostUSDPer1kTokens,
825					CostSource:         normalizeCostSource(p.CostSource),
826					Power:              power,
827					Eligible:           eligible,
828					Reason:             reason,
829					FilterReason:       filterReason,
830					LatencyMS:          latencyMS,
831					SuccessRate:        providerSuccessRate,
832					CostClass:          h.CostClass,
833					SpeedTPS:           obs,
834					QuotaOK:            h.QuotaOK,
835					QuotaPercentUsed:   h.QuotaPercentUsed,
836					QuotaTrend:         h.QuotaTrend,
837				},
838				internal: ci,
839			})
840		}
841		return out
842	}

897	// resolveModel picks the concrete model string for a (harness, provider) pair
898	// given the request. Returns the model and a non-empty rejection reason if
899	// resolution fails.
900	func resolveModel(h HarnessEntry, p ProviderEntry, req Request, in Inputs) (string, string) {
901		// 1. Exact pin.
902		if req.Model != "" {
903			// If the provider has discovery data, try fuzzy matching to map the
904			// canonical/short ref to the provider-native ID.
905			if len(p.DiscoveredIDs) > 0 {
906				if matched := FuzzyMatch(req.Model, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
907					return matched, ""
908				}
909				return "", fmt.Sprintf("model %q not on provider %q", req.Model, p.Name)
910			}
911			if p.DiscoveryAttempted {
912				return "", fmt.Sprintf("provider %q has no live discovered models", p.Name)
913			}
914			return req.Model, ""
915		}
916	
917		// 2. Catalog ref.
918		if req.ModelRef != "" {
919			if in.CatalogResolver != nil {
920				if concrete, ok := in.CatalogResolver(req.ModelRef, h.Surface); ok {
921					// If discovery is available, double-check the concrete ID
922					// (or the original ref) appears on this provider.
923					if len(p.DiscoveredIDs) > 0 {
924						if matched := FuzzyMatch(concrete, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
925							return matched, ""
926						}
927						// Try the original ref against discovery.
928						if matched := FuzzyMatch(req.ModelRef, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
929							return matched, ""
930						}
931						return "", fmt.Sprintf("model ref %q not on provider %q", req.ModelRef, p.Name)
932					}
933					return concrete, ""
934				}
935				return "", fmt.Sprintf("model ref %q not available on surface %q", req.ModelRef, h.Surface)
936			}
937			if p.DiscoveryAttempted {
938				return "", fmt.Sprintf("provider %q has no live discovered models", p.Name)
939			}
940			// No catalog: pass the ref through.
941			return req.ModelRef, ""
942		}
943	
944		// 3. Profile.
945		if req.Profile != "" {
946			if in.CatalogResolver != nil {
947				if concrete, ok := in.CatalogResolver(req.Profile, h.Surface); ok {
948					// If discovery is available, verify the resolved model exists.
949					if len(p.DiscoveredIDs) > 0 {
950						if matched := FuzzyMatch(concrete, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
951							return matched, ""
952						}
953						// Also try the original profile ref (handles bare-leaf refs
954						// against discovery). Fixes ddx-2f5a2284.
955						if matched := FuzzyMatch(req.Profile, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
956							return matched, ""
957						}
958						return "", fmt.Sprintf("profile %q resolves to %q but provider %q does not serve it", req.Profile, concrete, p.Name)
959					}
960					return concrete, ""
961				}
962				// No catalog mapping for this surface — fall through to defaults
963				// only if defaults exist; otherwise reject so escalation skips
964				// this candidate (fixes ddx-3c5ba7cc).
965				if p.DefaultModel == "" && h.DefaultModel == "" {
966					return "", fmt.Sprintf("profile %q not available on surface %q", req.Profile, h.Surface)
967				}
968			} else if p.DefaultModel == "" && h.DefaultModel == "" {
969				return "", fmt.Sprintf("profile %q not available on surface %q", req.Profile, h.Surface)
970			}
971			// No catalog hit; fall through to default.
972		}
973	
974		// 4. Provider default → harness default. Empty default is acceptable
975		// when no request fields constrained model selection — orphan validation
976		// happens at dispatch time.
977		if p.DefaultModel != "" {
978			if len(p.DiscoveredIDs) > 0 {
979				if matched := FuzzyMatch(p.DefaultModel, p.DiscoveredIDs); matched != "" {
980					return matched, ""
981				}
982				return "", fmt.Sprintf("provider default %q not on provider %q", p.DefaultModel, p.Name)
983			}
984			return p.DefaultModel, ""
985		}
986		if h.DefaultModel != "" {
987			return h.DefaultModel, ""
988		}
989		return "", ""
990	}

992	// EscalateProfileAware is a helper for tier escalation. Given a request that
993	// failed at one profile, return the next profile to try, restricted to those
994	// that have a viable candidate under the current Inputs (i.e., the profile's
995	// resolved concrete model exists on the request's pinned provider, if any).
996	//
997	// Fixes ddx-3c5ba7cc: tier escalation respects --provider affinity.
998	//
999	// Returns "" when no further profile is viable.
1000	func EscalateProfileAware(current string, ladder []string, req Request, in Inputs) string {
1001		startIdx := -1
1002		for i, p := range ladder {
1003			if p == current {
1004				startIdx = i
1005				break
1006			}
1007		}
1008		if startIdx < 0 {
1009			return ""
1010		}
1011		for i := startIdx + 1; i < len(ladder); i++ {
1012			next := ladder[i]
1013			probe := req
1014			probe.Profile = next
1015			if dec, err := Resolve(probe, in); err == nil && dec != nil && dec.Harness != "" {
1016				return next
1017			}
1018		}
1019		return ""
1020	}
